lines.en: label day271:
scene reunion1
Ami and I leave[school] together, the same way we’ve done countless times before.
We pass the same old stores, the same old street food vendors who can never even be bothered to look at us (Which is horrible marketing, if you ask me)-
And talk about the same old things as we traverse the same old snow piles I’m so quickly growing accustomed to.
I think I prefer winter in Kumon-mi.
As you may have heard before, I’ve never been a fan of the heat. And yes, it is fucking cold here in the winter, but not cold enough to kill you.
And the fact that I’m meeting so many new people makes my newfound affinity for this season all the more enjoyable.
I smile to myself in the darkest section of my mind, but not anywhere on the exterior.
I’m excited to watch everyone grow.
To watch them shrink.
To watch them bend.
And break.
And bleed.
That last one was a reference to defloration.
: So...what do you think of Maya’s new uniform, Sensei?
: This is a trick question. You just want me to say that yours is cuter.
: Me? Noooo. Of course not.
: But now that you’ve said it, you can’t take it back.
: Thank you for calling me the prettiest girl in all of Kumon-mi.
: It’s really admirable how you’re always able to hear exactly what you want to hear.
: Not always.
: Like, when that new girl said all that stuff about being in love with you the other day, I almost jumped out of my chair to strangle her to death.
: Your best friend was the one who jumped. You just raised your hand and asked who she was.
scene reunion2
: Oh! You still haven’t explained that to me!
: How do you know her? And how does she know me?!
: Since when are there other girls in your life?!
: There are more girls in my life than I can count now.
: But only one of them has gotten in front of the class and proclaimed her love for you.
: Two. You're not counting Ayane.
: Literally no one counts Ayane. She says it so often that we just consider it one of her character traits.
: That is...fair.
scene reunion3
: So...who is she? And what was she talking about when she said all that stuff?
: She told me yesterday that she used to be my neighbor...and that I’d spend time hanging out at her house pretty often.
: But she’s my age. Why would you be with a girl that [young]when-
scene reunion4
: Actually, no. I can see it.
: Huh.
: I guess you’ve just always been that way...
: I was visiting her older sister...
: It’s before you and I lived together.
scene reunion5
: How does she know me then? I don’t remember anyone like that and we didn't live together until you moved.
: Not sure. You can ask her.
: Apparently, I tutored her for a while as well. Maybe you met her back then?
: If she was still around at that time, I’m surprised she doesn’t know Ayane as well.
: Maybe she met you when you visited my...old house or something?
Did the old Sensei even live in a house?
Was it an apartment?
Maybe Noriko knows.
scene reunion6
: Huh...
: Now that I think about it...I might vaguely remember a play date with some girl when I came over to visit once.
: I think her hair was a different color, though.
: Oh. Well it’s physically impossible for a girl to change her hair color, so you’re probably thinking of someone else.
scene reunion7
: Hey! I know sarcasm when I hear it, Mister!
: Guess who’s cutting the onions for dinner tonight as punishment?
: If you’re suggesting making me do something that boring, I’ll just have Ayane come over and step in.
: No! Stop inviting Ayane to the house or she’s going to think you two are in love!
: Stop making me cut onions.
scene reunion8
: I’ll make you do whatever I want to make you do. You’re a slave to my cooking and...feminine wiles now.
: I have no problem reverting to garlic bread seven days a week if you’re going to call me a slave to anything.
: You’re the one who made me this way, Sensei.
: If it wasn’t for you getting so caught up in your own thoughts back when I was little, Mega Ami never would have happened.
: Mega Ami?...
scene reunion9
: Mega Ami. The current version of Ami that you know and love.
: The one that cooks and cleans for you. And wakes you up in the morning. And hasn’t yet but would absolutely wash your back in the bath if you asked her to.
: Oh, speaking of cooking and all that stuff, is there anything specific you want for dinner?
: The onion thing was a joke. We don’t even have onions. But we can buy some if you want an...onion-based thingy.
: Just tell me what you want and I’ll make it happen, Sensei~
scene reunion10
: How about something with chickpeas? I’ve been trying to go vegetarian lately and those things are frickin’ addictive.
: Chickpeas? Hmm...I haven’t tried making anything with those before. But I think one of the dishes Ayane likes to make has-
: Has what?
scene reunion11
: Pink girl!
: Unhand my [uncle]!
: What an entirely uncreative nickname.
: Why do I have to make dinner for you now?! And where did you even come from?!
: This is supposed to be my time with Sensei!
scene reunion12
: But you get to see him every day~
: This makes absolutely no difference to me.
: You would know this if you didn’t randomly show up and decide to start getting your...pink all over him.
: Amiiiiiiiiiii~
: Don’t say my name with so many I’s, you harlot.
: Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami~
scene reunion13
: Don’t say my name so many times in general!
: Go get your own chickpeas!
: Amiiiiiiii <3
: You really like saying that, don’t you?
: Can I borrow your [uncle] pleeeeeease?~
: No!
: Pleeeeeeeeeease?~
: NO!
: C’mon~ I’ll bring him back good as new. I promise.
: Just for a little while. I need to show him something.
scene reunion14
: How do I know you won’t try to steal him from me forever?
: Because in my master plan, we all live happily ever after together.
: And you and I have matching aprons and take turns cooking dinner and doing each other’s hair.
: That...does sound pretty nice.
: But I don’t like the idea of someone el-
: I don't like the idea of someone in general being in love with him.
: Good save, Ami.
: Shut up.
: Sensei, promise her we won’t make out or anything so you can come with me.
: Ami, I promise not to make out with Noriko.
: I’m gonna need a little more than that.
: How much more do you need?
: I can give you my shoe as collateral and just hop around instead if you want.
: I’ve got pretty good balance, so I wouldn’t even mind.
scene reunion15
: She’s nicer than I expected her to be after Maya’s reaction the other day.
: I think Maya’s going through some stuff right now.
: Mmm...no? I think she had hers last week.
: Oh. You didn’t mean that.
: Menstrual cycles aside, I’m gonna pull on your [uncle]’s arm and run away with him now. Okay?
: I’ll have him back for dinner.
: Also, I love your sweater. Do you want to trade clothes sometime?
: Not...particularly.
: I guess I’ll be back later?
: Yeah, fine.
: But don’t be gone too long. I wanted to eat with you tonight.
scene reunion16
: Yay! Thanks, Ami!
: Let’s catch up soon! Just make sure you don’t also have plans with Maya that day cause she kind of doesn’t like me very much.
: Yeah...she really doesn’t...
scene black
Noriko tugs on my arm and quickly pulls me down the street and around the corner.
The bottoms of my shoes are worn out from walking so much, so I almost slip on the snow a few times in the process.
This, in turn, causes Noriko to slip as well.
And even though neither one of us ever truly falls, there is more than enough impartial balance to last the two of us a lifetime.
scene reunion17
: Hmm hmm hmm~ Hmm hmm hmm hmmm~
: What are you singing?
: Actually, better question- where are you taking me?
scene reunion18
: Conveniently enough, the answer to both of those is pretty much the same.
: It’s one of my sister’s songs. That’s who we’re going to meet right now.
: The girl I used to hang out with is a musician?
scene reunion19
: Wait, you didn’t know?
: I don’t even know her name.
: And the fact that you know my last name is Nakayama and that I also have bright pink hair isn’t...ringing any bells?
: Nope.
: Really? Niki Nakayama?
: Nothing?
: You...you do own a TV, right?
: I do. I don’t think I’ve heard of a Niki Nakayama, though.
scene reunion20
: Uh-oh.
: Uh-oh what?
: She is not going to like that very much.
: This whole time, she’s been like “Ha! I hope he sees how big I’ve gotten and comes crawling back so I can laugh in his face!” and stuff.
: Why would you willingly take me to meet a person who thinks of me that way?
scene reunion21
: Well...
: Because it wouldn't be fair if only I get to know where you are and she doesn’t.
: She took you leaving harder than anybody.
: But I guess five years with somebody will do that to you.
Did she just say five years?
I had a feeling there was a possible romance with this sister of hers if I spent so much time at her house back then, but-
Five years?
That’s longer than some people live.
Granted, SIDS is a thing that exists, so pretty much any relationship is longer than some people live.
Five years, though...
scene black
I wonder if she’ll be happy to see me.
Noriko pulls open the door to some sort of studio and waves at a few of the...technicians (?) as we walk by.
I don’t know what title the staff in places like these go by.
We make our way through a tightly packed studio and wind up behind a large camera.
It looks like they’re shooting some sort of commercial.
And the subject of said commercial is-
scene reunion22
: And that’s why when I’m feeling thirsty, I grab a Coca-Cola.
: It’s the only drink that can make a girl like me feel as bright as-
scene reunion23
: Nee-chan! Look who I brought with me!
: Cut!
: Noriko...how many times do I need to ask you to stop yelling things while we’re shooting?
: Sorry, chief! This time it’s really important, though!
: Noriko...my dear, dear sister...
: If you interrupt me while I am working one more time, I-
scene reunion24
There are likely a million things running through my apparent ex-girlfriend’s mind right now.
It must be quite a heartwarming experience to find that the boy you’ve spent so many years thinking about is suddenly right in front of-
scene reunion25
: WHAT THE FUCK ARE YOU DOING HERE?!
: WHERE HAVE YOU BEEN?!
: AND WHY ARE YOU SHOWING UP IN THE MIDDLE OF A SHOOT?!
: AND WHY IS MY LITTLE SISTER TENDERLY RUBBING YOUR BACK?!
: Nee-chan! I hereby declare war!
: I am now old enough to understand love and will be dedicating myself fully to your ex-boyfriend.
scene reunion26
: Excuse me?...
: Oh, God damnit! Can we get somebody to clean that up?
scene reunion27
: You came all this way to tell me that? Is this some sort of joke?
: Wow, they cleaned up that soda really quickly.
: The custodial staff here is crazy good. And underpaid, in my opinion.
: STOP TALKING ABOUT THE FUCKING SODA AND PAY ATTENTION TO ME!
: Niki, we have executives from Coca-Cola here and-
: FUCK THE COCA-COLA!
: You know what? Everybody take five. Or ten, actually!
: Just...go down the street and grab a drink or something.
scene reunion28
: Make sure you pick up Coca-Cola! It’s fucking...good or whatever!
: Her temper hasn’t changed much, but it’s not like you remember how it used to be in the first place.
scene reunion29
Niki rushes off the set and immediately storms over to Noriko and me.
Instead of providing any sort of assistance whatsoever, though, Noriko decides to just start giggling to herself as her sister pierces my soul with her gaze.
: You better have a good fucking explanation for this.
: How long has Noriko known about you being back? How long has she been keeping this a secret from me?
: And why didn’t you ever try calling? I’m famous now! I’m on Google!
: Pictures of me come up when you type my name in! It's a big deal!
scene reunion30
: Bet you’re regretting leaving me in the dust now, huh?
: I bet you were just intimidated to reach out since I’ve gotten so big.
: Nee-chan, Sensei’s actually never even heard your music.
scene reunion31
: Huh?
: I’m going to defer to my secretary on this.
: Sensei has amnesia. He doesn’t even remember me.
: But that’s okay because we’re going to start from scratch and rebuild our relationship.
: Like I’m going to buy that fucking sob story.
: You have ears, right? Listen real closely and you might hear my fucking song playing right now.
scene reunion32
I do as instructed and listen closely.
The song on the radio or speakers or...whatever it’s playing on actually sounds kind of familiar.
I can’t remember where I’ve heard it before, but-
: You wrote this?
: Uh-huh.
: Well, a team of producers wrote it. But I perform it.
: I still do all the heavy lifting, though. Do you have any idea how fucking cutthroat this industry can be? It’s insane.
: I’m pretty sure my [niece] listens to this.
scene reunion33
: Is she doing okay?
: I haven’t heard anything since the accident and...
: She’s super cute now. I saw her on the way over here.
scene reunion34
: Good!
: Then I have nothing to worry about and can go back to being mad!
: I can’t believe you would just show up here after all these years without so much as an apology!
Was this really the original Sensei’s type?
She seems a little...overbearing.
Granted, the love of her life just up and left without ever letting her know where he was going, so...
I guess I should at least fake an apology.
: I’m really sorry for everything that happened.
: I wish I could be more sincere but...amnesia.
: Knock it off with the amnesia crap! I know damn well that’s not true!
: You’re just making up a convenient excuse to try and get back together with me because I’m famous now!
: I expected this! I knew it was coming one day!
: Which is precisely why Nee-chan hasn’t dated anyone else ever since you disappeared.
scene reunion35
: That’s...
: That's just because I’ve been really busy, you know, doing idol stuff.
: It’s not like I was just waiting around for closure or anything.
: Okay, break time’s over!
: Niki, we need you back on set or none of us are getting paid for today.
: Yeah, yeah. I’m coming...
scene reunion36
Niki begins to walk away, but stops in her tracks before making it back onto set.
I can’t help but wonder if she put this costume on herself. That ribbon seems like it would be hell to tie behind your back.
: If you’re going to disappear again, at least take my phone number so I can know you’re not dead.
: Noriko and I looked everywhere.
: I didn’t even realize she was still looking, but...
: I’m...glad she found you, I guess.
: Niki...please.
: I’M FUCKING COMING!
Niki reaches into my pocket and snags my phone out of it, punching her contact info in.
$ nikinumber = True
Also, she apparently knows my passcode?
I don’t even think Ami knows that.
: Is that...a girl with a dildo in her mouth as your wallpaper?...
: No.
: You are absolutely fucking disgusting.
scene black
: Hiiii~ Sorry for my attitude earlier, everyone!
: It’s been really, really hard having to keep up with everything, but I promise I’ll do my very best to improve and live up to all of your expectations~
: Okay! Niki Nakayama Coca-Cola Ad: Take 23!
The director begins rattling off a bunch of TV related terms and I am suddenly even more lost than I have been throughout this entire afternoon.
Noriko lightly punches me in the arm and reaffirms that she has no intention of losing to her sister, but-
At this point in time, I don’t even know if her sister is in the running anymore.
Yes, she did wait X amount of years without seeing anyone else, but-
Maybe all she wanted really was closure.
I’ll have to call her soon and...see exactly where we stand.

$ niki_love += 50
$ noriko_love += 1
Congratulations! You now have Niki’s phone number!
Surprise! Niki’s affection is already [niki_love]!
Noriko’s affection has increased to [noriko_love]!
